body:
Autonomous execution now requires the Operator to choose models/settings for each planned role and agree expenditure/concurrency boundaries before role work begins. Defaults and inherited settings cannot satisfy the gate; unsupported choices and changes outside the approved scope pause affected work. Approval carries through its recorded scope without repeated requests for unchanged assignments.

The change also:

- Defaults substantive work to one implementer and one independent reviewer, with justified extra contexts and explicit mutation/index ownership.
- Connects compact preflight and contributor handoffs to complete governing instructions, real substrate checks and stable input states. External-action authority includes automatic CI effects.
- Defines evidence batches as indexes into existing canonical homes. Every ledger row, original failed/successful attempt, independent observation and higher-scale review remains preserved. Mechanical facts retain their derivation, and model/configuration provenance supports later reconstruction.
- Adds reconstruction-oriented follow-through and distinguishes missing/retained/fresh proof, zero-test success, loading failure, candidate delivery and integrated outcomes.

**Compatibility:** the mandatory pre-dispatch approval deliberately changes the Autonomous execution contract. Composer, engineering-methods, project-management and agent-coordination receive major version bumps; supporting work-verification, testing and stewardship guidance receive minor bumps. Each owning metadata/history pair is updated. Existing historical records, issued prompts and independent/Operator gates remain intact; no prescribed model/provider or new validator service is introduced.

**Validation**

- `make check-skills` — passed.
- `make check-package-paths` — passed; 25 source skills and 25 generated packages, zero version-contract errors and zero hard path failures. The path auditor reports 621 categorized warnings and three explicit exceptions; full output and affected bundle snapshots are retained in the planning worktree.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Static contract self-review covers missing/inherited model approval, unavailable choices, bounded substitutions, reviewer repairs, concurrent mutations, zero selected tests and evidence retention. These are author checks, not independent acceptance or a behavioral trial.

Refs #6. This PR delivers source/guidance for review; the issue's bounded real evaluation remains pending. No live Autonomous trial, installed-skill update, release or merge is claimed. The Operator and two separately supplied reviewer instances will review this candidate through the PR.

Review should examine whether the model/spend gate has bypasses, whether the evidence/index rules preserve full ledger effectiveness and later research utility, and whether standalone/composed routes convey the same contract.
